title: Global Customs & Trade Compliance Executive
description:
Job Description Summary

Are you ready to see your career take flight? At GE Aerospace, we believe the world works better when it flies. We are a world-leading provider of jet engines, components, and integrated systems for commercial and military aircraft. We have a relentless dedication to the future of safe and more sustainable flight and believe in our talented people to make it happen.

The Global Executive Customs & Trade Compliance Leader is responsible for setting and executing the global strategy for customs operations, trade compliance, tariff management, and duty optimization across GE Aerospace. In this role, you will lead global risk management for export and import operations, oversees compliant execution of high-volume cross-border shipments, and ensures adherence to GE Aerospace Enterprise Standards and regulatory requirements in all regions.

This leader owns a portfolio of significant annualized duty avoidance, savings, and refunds and is accountable for building a high-performing global organization, strengthening controls, enabling business growth, and protecting GE Aerospace’s license to operate. The position leads a global operations team and functional experts across four regions (UK, EMEA, Americas, APAC), overseeing customs brokers, vendors, and site-level processes for approximately 150 locations and 150,000-200,000 shipments annually.

Key Skills & Competencies
Strategic leadership
Ability to set global vision, prioritize initiatives, and align stakeholders around execution

Risk management & compliance
Identify, assess, and mitigate customs, tariff, and trade compliance risks

Tariff & special program strategy
Design/implement global tariff management and special program optimization

People leadership & development
Lead/develop global teams and build succession pipelines
Will lead a team of 34 direct reports and 66 contingent workers

Executive communication
Strong written and verbal communication with senior leaders and regulators

Change management
Lead organizational change (new policies, tools, regulatory requirements)

Continuous improvement
Use data/audits/feedback to drive simplification, standardization, and process improvement

Vendor & brokerage management
Manage/develop/control brokers/vendors to meet performance and compliance goals

Cross-functional influence
Influence peers and leaders outside own function; communicate complex plans in executive-friendly formats

Job Description

Role & Responsibilities

Global strategy, governance & risk management

  • Define and execute GE Aerospace’s global customs and trade compliance strategy (including tariff management and special program optimization).
  • Establish governance mechanisms (e.g., risk councils, operating reviews) and maintain a global risk assessment framework/methodology.
  • Own global KPIs and reporting across risk indicators, Enterprise Standard conformance, audit outcomes, lead times, tariff exposure, and duty optimization results.

Global operations leadership

  • Lead the global customs and trade compliance operations team across four regions (UK, EMEA, Americas, APAC).
  • Provide executive oversight of classification, valuation, origin determination, special programs, and recordkeeping across approximately 150 sites.
  • Coordinate with Supply Chain, Logistics, Finance, Legal, Engineering, and business units to integrate customs/trade requirements end-to-end in alignment with control tower standards and strategy.

Customs brokerage management, development & control

  • Manage, develop, and control customs brokers and vendors globally, including selection in alignment with Sourcing and Transportation strategy, onboarding, contractual conformance, and performance management.
  • Establish and maintain controls, standards, and operating procedures for brokerage activities to ensure consistent classification, valuation, documentation, and recordkeeping.

Duty optimization, tariff management & special programs

  • Own and manage significant annualized duty avoidance, savings, and refunds through tariff management, trade programs, and special regimes.
  • Lead tariff strategies (classification governance, origin planning, valuation strategies) and mitigate tariffs, trade remedies, and surcharges.
  • Drive special program optimization (e.g., FTAs, duty drawback, inward/outward processing, bonded warehouses, foreign trade zones, Trusted Trader Programs).
  • Lead the global HS classification program to improve governance, accuracy, and consistency.
  • Provide executive oversight of global BPO provider programs supporting customs and trade compliance.

Compliance investigations, audits & government engagement

  • Investigate compliance defects, identify root cause, and lead corrective actions to closure.
  • Manage the government disclosure process including voluntary disclosures and related corrective actions.
  • Lead global external audit preparation and execution; serve as escalation point for regulatory matters.
  • Ensure Trusted Trader Program requirements (e.g., AEO, ISA, CTPAT-equivalent) are met and maintained globally.

Export operations compliance & business enablement

  • Lead export operations compliance globally, embedding export control requirements (licensing, screening, sanctions/embargo compliance, documentation, recordkeeping) into processes and systems.
  • Assess complex/high-risk shipments and provide guidance while supporting delivery needs.
  • Contribute to new engines, services, and contract negotiations by advising on customs/trade/tariff considerations.

Policy, procedure, training & continuous improvement

  • Lead policy/procedure management including global standards, work instructions, and internal controls.
  • Lead training programs for customs/trade compliance, tariff management, and special program usage.
  • Champion continuous improvement using lean principles and digital solutions to reduce lead time, improve quality, and enhance visibility/control.

People leadership & development

  • Lead, coach, and develop a global team (including four Region Leaders), building a high-performance, diverse, and inclusive organization.
  • Own employee development including capability building, training, career development, and succession planning.
  • Foster a culture of integrity, accountability, learning, and continuous improvement; role model GE Aerospace behaviors/values with alignment to safety, quality, delivery, and cost priorities.

In addition:

  • Overseeing customs brokers/vendors and site-level processes for ~150 locations and 150,000-200,000 imports annually
  • Ensuring compliance and operations of Free Trade Zone (FTZ operations)
  • Leading business continuity

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Law, International Trade, or related field from an accredited college or university
  • A minimum of 8 years of experience in customs, trade compliance, global logistics, or related operations roles
  • A minimum of 5 years of direct people leadership experience

Additional Information

  • Ability and willingness to travel up to 10% based on business needs

Desired Qualifications

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in Business, Law, Supply Chain, or related discipline
  • 12+ years of experience in customs, trade compliance, global logistics, or related operations roles
  • Proven track record leading global or multi-regional teams and managing leaders of teams
  • Deep expertise in customs regulations, import/export requirements, tariff management, and global trade regimes across multiple jurisdictions
  • Demonstrated experience managing large-scale programs/initiatives, including risk and cost reduction
  • Professional certifications in customs or trade compliance (e.g., CCS, LCB, similar) or equivalent experience
  • Aerospace, industrial, or similarly regulated global industries
  • Experience leading duty optimization, tariff mitigation, and special program strategies with material financial impact
  • Experience managing external audits and voluntary disclosures with customs authorities
  • Experience using digital tools, data analytics, and dashboards to drive performance and risk reduction
  • Experience partnering with Supply Chain, Legal, Finance, IT, Engineering, and business leadership

title: Post Doctoral NIH Rsch Fellow
description:
SUMMARY: The Postdoctoral Research Training in Child Health EquityProgram is designed to prepare MD and PhD postdoctoral fellows with the knowledge, skills, and experiences necessary to conduct child health equity research with pediatric populations with a focus on respiratory, cardiovascular/metabolic and sleep health, and related lifestyle behaviors. The program will prepare postdoctoral trainees each year who will obtain a strong background in child health equity research methods and skills to develop impactful, rigorous community-engaged research to reduces health disparities. The program will integrate: 1) team-based research mentorship from investigators who have expertise in the targeted areas of focus, 2) rigorous didactic training that integrates consideration of child health equity in all aspects of the research process, 3) training in state-of-the-art clinical research and community focused methodologies, and 4) professional development opportunities to promote academic careers in child health equity. Fellows will have an MD with training in a related specialty (e.g., pediatrics, obstetrics/gynecology, emergency medicine, psychiatry) or PhD in a behavioral health-related field (psychology, public health/epidemiology, sociology). The Postdoctoral Research Training in Child Health EquityProgram will allow fellows to emerge as innovative and productive independent investigators through (i) intensive mentorship in an apprentice model by expert faculty mentors (ii) cutting-edge and foundational didactics, and (iii) formulation of an independent research project and grant proposal. Mentors include PhDs and MDs with a breadth of research interests and transdisciplinary expertise from pediatrics and associated specialties, behavioral science, and public health. Postdoctoral fellowships typically involve two full-time research training years. MD applicants may be able to integrate the fellowship as a more in-depth research component within an established clinical fellowship program at Brown (applicants will need to separately be accepted into those training programs). Brown University Health employees are expected to successfully role model the organization's values of Compassion, Accountability, Respect, and Excellence as these values guide our everyday actions with patients, customers and one another. In addition to our values, all employees are expected to demonstrate the core Success Factors which tell us how we work together and how we get things done. The core Success Factors include: Instill Trust and Value Differences Patient and Community Focus and Collaborate RESPONSIBILITIES: Fellows are responsible for knowing and acting in accordance with the principles of the Brown University Health Corporate Compliance Program and Code of Conduct. Ability to meet physical and non-physical demands as outlined in the job description is an essential function of the job. The program embraces an mentorship team model where fellows work closely with two mentors to develop both content expertise in one of the health conditions of focus and methodological skills in one of three areas: qualitative methods, implementation science, or health advocacy. Fellows will also receive training from faculty with expertise in methodologies (e.g., implementation science, qualitative research, specific biostatistics analyses) and designs (e.g., observational, experimental, intervention-based), focusing on prevention, identification of risk/resource/protective factors, intervention/treatment research, and/or dissemination and implementation, consistent with their research goals The fellows will obtain rigorous foundational training in research design and statistics, grant-writing, responsible conduct of research, professional development, and cutting- edge methodological approaches. The program leverages content areas from pediatrics, public health, and behavioral science, allowing for a large base of trainee colleagues, faculty experts, didactics and support. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS: Physicians with relevant residency training or doctoral level behavioral, social, or public health scientists who are pursuing research areas focused on child health equity related to pediatrics, respiratory conditions, cardiovascular/metabolic and sleep health. For those from schools of psychology or public heath, completion of all requirements for a doctoral degree. In addition, for those in clinical psychology, evidence of relevant clinical training at the graduate and internship level with attestation of completion provided by program director or diploma. For those with medical degrees graduation from an approved medical program and relevant residency training (e.g. pediatrics, obstetrics/gynecology).EXPERIENCE: Completion of all requirements for PhD, Psy.D., DrPH or M.D. from a relevant doctorate program and completion of a psychology internship or medical residency for those with clinical degrees.INDEPENDENT ACTION:Performs independently within the department’s policies and practices. Refers specific complex problems to the supervisor when clarification of the departmental policies and procedures are required.SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY: Supervision of trainees may be included dependent upon the research and clinical foci of training.

description:
As a Salesforce Solution Architect, you are responsible for leading the design and implementation of Salesforce solutions that meet the business needs of PRO-spectus. This position works closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, analyze business processes, and develop comprehensive solutions leveraging the Salesforce platform. Your role will involve architecting scalable and sustainable solutions, guiding development teams, and ensuring alignment with best practices and industry standards.

This role will have a strong understanding of Salesforce CRM and its capabilities, coupled with the ability to customize and configure Salesforce to meet the needs of PRO-spectus. This role requires excellent communication skills, problem-solving abilities, and a deep understanding of PRO-spectus business processes.

Core Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Requirements Gathering:

    • Designing and implementing seamless integrations between Salesforce and other enterprise systems, including ERP, client CRMs, marketing automation, and other third-party applications.

Where Your Career is a Force for Good!

We are seeking a Donor Care Specialist for our Charlotte, NC Office located at: 13500 South Point Blvd, Ste L., Charlotte, NC 28273

Shift: Tuesday - Saturday, Second Shift , 3:00pm - 11:30pm.

Pay Information: The salary for this position is $22.60/ hr. + Shift Differential (+$1.75 after 3pm, + $2.75 on weekends)

This is a HYBRID position - After the required training period the employee will be required to report and work in the office twice a month

Responsibilities

1. Manage routine to moderately complex donor complication cases from the donation process by providing appropriate care for donors and asking probing questions to ensure facts of the case are known. Take appropriate and timely action in response to additional information provided by donors.

2. Provide timely, accurate and helpful answers to donors and staff regarding donor eligibility, complaints and concerns and manage cases to resolution and timely closure. Escalate difficult or sensitive questions as needed.

3. Perform medical director/designee review and quality review for donor complication cases to ensure quality and regulatory standards are maintained.

4. Investigate discrepancies in donor records. Correct, update and verify changes to donor records to ensure appropriate entry and confidential handling of donor data. Identify and control impacted suspect products resulting from changes.

5. Monitor security to ensure only authorized personnel have access to confidential donor records.

6. Prepare reports regarding donor complication cases.

Scope

Work performed within a specialized discipline typically requiring a medical/scientific certification or licensure. Work under clear guidelines and supervision to perform tasks and resolve problems. Has regular contact with physicians, field staff and other internal and external customers.

Qualifications

Education: High School or equivalent with medical certification such as Registered Nurse (RN), Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) or Medical Laboratory Professional (MT or MLT) required. Associate’s degree preferred.

Experience: Minimum 1 year of experience in patient care, blood collections or patient testing or equivalent combination of education and related experience required.

Management Experience: N/A

Skills & Abilities: Excellent written and verbal skills and ability to probe donors to elicit a complete and accurate health history is required. Intermediate to advanced level computer skills with Microsoft Office applications in a Windows environment is required. Ability to work on a team.

Travel: Some travel may be required.

Bilingual is helpful

** New Graduates are encouraged to apply **

*Combination of candidate’s education and general experience satisfies requirements so long as the total years equate to description’s minimum education and general experience years combined (Management experience cannot be substituted).

Physical Requirements

The duties are representative of the essential functions of the position. Physical requirements are those present in normal office environment conditions. Operational flexibility is required to meet sudden and unpredictable needs. Ability to use a personal computer and applicable software for sustained periods of time.

BENEFITS FOR YOU:

We take care of you, while you take care of others. As a mission-based organization, we believe our team needs great support to do great work. Our comprehensive benefits help you in balancing home and work. With our resources and perks, you have amazing possibilities at the American Red Cross to advance the learn.

title: Senior Controls Engineer
description:
Are you ready to be part of a company that's not just talking about the future, but actively shaping it? Join The AES Corporation, the largest US-based global power company with a team of 8,300 employees across 12 countries.

AES has been ranked #1 by BloombergNEF in renewable energy sales to corporations in the US and Americas for five consecutive years, providing electricity for millions of people worldwide.

We are proud to foster a strong workplace culture, earning prominent positions in Great Place to Work™ rankings across the markets where we operate. AES was also named one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies for the 13th consecutive year in 2026, highlighting our dedication to integrity, transparency, and responsible business practices.

Our spirit of innovation continues to earn industry recognition. AES is the only seven-time winner of the Edison Electric Institute’s Edison Awards in the twenty-first century, a distinction honoring global leadership in advancing the electric power industry.

If you're ready to be part of a company that's not just adapting to change, but driving it, AES is the place for you. We're not just building a more sustainable future, we're powering it. Apply now and energize your career with a true leader in global energy.


Position Summary

The Senior Controls Engineer will lead the design, testing, commissioning, and continuous improvement of plant-level control systems for utility-scale solar and battery energy storage projects.

This role provides technical leadership for Power Plant Controller (PPC), Energy Management System (EMS), and supervisory control solutions that support safe, reliable, and compliant plant operations. The position partners closely with internal teams, OEMs, EPCs, and operations stakeholders to define control strategies, evaluate designs, and support successful project execution from design through commercial operation.

The ideal candidate brings strong experience with renewable energy controls, technical problem solving, and cross-functional collaboration in a fast-paced project environment.

We are open to considering U.S. remote-based candidates, preferably located in the Pacific (PST) time zone.

Key Responsibilities

Control Strategy Development and Implementation

  • Design, develop, and maintain plant-level control logic for utility-scale solar PV and BESS facilities, including PPC, EMS, and supervisory control systems.

  • Develop control strategies for active power control (APC), reactive power control (RPC), frequency response, voltage regulation, ramp rate limiting, and state-of-charge (SOC) management for hybrid solar and storage facilities, ensuring performance under expected grid operating conditions.

  • Develop control logic in IEC-61131-3 environments such as Codesys, AcSELerator, Beckhoff TwinCAT, or equivalent platforms.

  • Review OEM and EPC-supplied control strategies and design documentation, identify gaps and risks, and provide recommendations that support successful commissioning and long-term operational performance.

  • Define and support control interfaces for inverter OEMs and BESS vendors, including protocols such as Modbus, DNP3, and IEC 61850.

Controller Modeling and Validation

  • Develop and review dynamic controller models in PSS/E to support interconnection and controls validation activities.

  • Support EMT modeling and validation activities in PSCAD/EMTDC to identify and resolve control design issues before field implementation.

  • Support NERC MOD-026 and MOD-027 submissions and respond to ISO/RTO model review comments alongside the power systems team.

Testing, Commissioning, and Issue Resolution

  • Develop structured test plans for new control features and product releases, with clear acceptance criteria and documented pass/fail expectations.

  • Support HIL testing environments (RTDS, OPAL-RT, or equivalent) for controller validation before hardware ever touches a real plant.

  • Lead or support factory and site acceptance testing (FAT/SAT), including setpoint verification, alarm and trip logic validation, and SCADA communications checkout, while escalating issues and driving resolution as needed.

  • Support root cause analysis and corrective action development for post-commercial-operation issues, ensuring lessons learned are incorporated into future designs and processes.

Technical Standards and Documentation

  • Ensure control designs comply with applicable standards, including IEEE 1547, IEEE 2800, relevant NERC requirements, and project interconnection obligations.

  • Develop clear and complete documentation, including functional specifications, logic descriptions, I/O lists, test procedures, and commissioning reports that support consistency, maintainability, and knowledge transfer.

  • Stay current on evolving inverter-based resource grid code requirements and apply those insights to engineering standards and project delivery.

Cross-Functional Collaboration and Technical Leadership

  • Partner with project development, engineering, and construction teams to support equipment selection, vendor evaluation, and early identification of controls-related risks.

  • Collaborate with SCADA, commissioning, and operations teams to support reliable plant performance through startup and ongoing operations.

  • Provide technical guidance to less-experienced engineers through knowledge sharing, design review, and coaching to support team capability and quality outcomes.

Minimum Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, or a closely related field required.

  • Equivalent combinations of education and relevant experience may be considered in accordance with company policy and business needs.

Experience

  • 5+ years of controls engineering experience, including work with utility-scale solar PV and/or BESS facilities.

  • Experience developing control strategies for grid-connected renewable energy assets.

  • Experience reviewing OEM or EPC control submissions and functional design documents, and providing substantive technical feedback.

  • Working knowledge of PSS/E or PSCAD for controller-level modeling and validation.

  • Hands-on experience with PPC or EMS commissioning and acceptance testing for utility-scale renewable projects.

Technical Skills

  • IEC-61131-3 control logic development in Codesys, AcSELerator, Beckhoff TwinCAT, or equivalent PLC-based environments.

  • Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills, with the ability to trace issues through software, controls interfaces, and system behavior.

  • Working knowledge of PSS/E and/or PSCAD at the controller level.

  • Communication protocols: Modbus TCP/RTU, DNP3, IEC 61850 (GOOSE/MMS), SunSpec.

  • SCADA/historian familiarity: PI Historian, OSIsoft, or equivalent.

  • Python or MATLAB/Simulink for control analysis, test automation, or data evaluation.

Standards Knowledge

  • IEEE 1547-2018 and IEEE 2800-2022 interconnection requirements for inverter-based resources.

  • NERC MOD-026, MOD-027, and PRC-024 familiarity.

  • General awareness of UL 9540 / UL 9540A for BESS systems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • HIL testing experience with RTDS/RSCAD, OPAL-RT, or Speedgoat

  • MATLAB/Simulink for control modeling or algorithm prototyping

  • BESS dispatch optimization, degradation-aware SOC management, or demand response control strategies

  • Experience with Emerson Ovation, ABB Ability, or Schweitzer SEL platforms in renewable energy applications

  • Working knowledge of interconnection processes at ERCOT, CAISO, MISO, PJM, or WECC as they relate to controls and model submissions

  • Familiarity with OT/ICS cybersecurity frameworks (IEC 62443, NERC CIP basics)

  • Professional Engineer (PE) license

4.Demonstrates knowledge of the location of all emergency equipment and supplies.

1.Demonstrates knowledge of and adheres to hospital and departmental safety regulations, disaster plans, infection control policies, fire safety regulations, hazardous materials disposal.

description:
Company Overview

Amperesand is reinventing how the world powers its most critical systems.

We are facing a once-in-a-generation opportunity for infrastructure disruption. Electricity demand is skyrocketing, driven by AI factories, electric vehicles, and modern industrial growth. Energy supply is shifting to incorporate a more diverse mix of resources – including solar, gas, and batteries – at a massive scale.

And yet the power infrastructure behind our latest mega-projects hasn’t meaningfully changed in nearly 100 years. Supply chains for today’s infrastructure equipment can’t match the pace and sophistication of critical energy projects. Amperesand is building hardware and software that rewrites this broken power infrastructure playbook to support a new era of energy abundance.

We’ve built a new class of intelligent, software-defined power infrastructure products leveraging a decade of advanced medium voltage Solid State Transformer research that’s now ready for commercial deployment.

Our products and solutions go far beyond the capabilities of traditional electrical equipment. We make power systems that are faster to deploy, dramatically smaller and more efficient, and capable of supporting modern, dynamic energy needs for tomorrow’s most demanding energy consumers.

Scalable in-house advanced manufacturing capability is our foundation for meeting timeline and quality expectation to serve infrastructure customers around the world.

Amperesand is led by breakthrough energy hardware development veterans and funded by top tier investors who share our vision of building a category-defining energy technology company.

With hubs in San Francisco, Reno, and Singapore, our global team is laser focused on building foundational technology to solve the most pressing problems in power infrastructure at scale.

Join us in building the power foundation of the future!

Senior Packaging Engineer

The primary function of this position is to design in-bound part packaging optimized to protect components for domestic and international shipment, and to interface with part picking on our production lines. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including design, manufacturing, suppliers, quality, and program management. You will be directly responsible for Amperesand’s most unique and critical packaging designs.

• Deliver technical designs of packaging that are optimized to protect components, for weight, durability, and interfacing with material handling in the manufacturing line.

• Perform 3D modeling, FEA, and durability analysis of concept packaging designs.

• Design, source, build, and execute testing on prototype packaging.

• Conduct design reviews and ensure compliance to standards (ISTA, ASTM, etc.)

• Participate in packaging and component supplier evaluation.

• Partner with engineering teams in design, manufacturing, material handling, NPI, to develop designs and review requirements, from concept through production.

Participants are placed in a full-time position and assimilate into their business team on day 1. The FidYOU program kicks off in week 2 with a week long onboarding and teambuilding event in Westlake, Texas.

Upon completion of the robust 2 week on-boarding experience, participants begin training for their full-time role and come together monthly with their cohort for business unit networking and learning sessions focused on building skills and capabilities. As of week 3, you will be training in your business unit role while attending monthly development for the first two years.

FidYOU is crafted to support recent graduates in their assimilation to our culture and provides numerous opportunities throughout the 18 month experience for networking, relationship building and accelerated learning. The program meets the learner where they are and provides experiences for associates to learn and apply their newly developed skills in a safe cohort environment.   • The program starts in June 2027 and requires a bachelor's degree

  • The ability to interpret sophisticated client requests and communicate clearly

description:
About The Company

Built on a foundation of integrity, respect, and commitment, JPI stands out as one of the most active real estate developers and builders in the nation. More than just great communities, JPI is focused on leaving a lasting impact on the communities where we build and is continually committed to “Building What Matters.” JPI operates as a subsidiary of Sumitomo Forestry, which is recognized as one of the largest home builders in the United States.


Why work for us?

We have a 35-year track record of developing multifamily communities with responsibility, accountability, and integrity. Our stated purpose is to:

  • Transform Building

  • Enhance Communities

  • Improve Lives

JPI has an ambitious and exciting vision for how we will achieve this, which makes for a positive and dynamic work environment, with many opportunities for personal development and growth. As well as our highly competitive offering of compensation and benefits, we are committed to:

  • Transformative careers in a transformative company

  • Comprehensive training and development

  • Promotion from within at all levels of the organization

  • Borderless Careers, based on performance, potential, and personal ambition

Industry Recognition

  • NMHC - #1 Fastest Growing Developer; #2 Fastest Growing Building; #8 Largest National Developer; # 11 Largest National Builder

  • Real Page – Most active multifamily developer in DFW for the past 8 years

  • Dallas Business Journal Best Places to Work – 2023

  • Dallas Business Journal – Largest DFW Real Estate Developers - #11

JPI offers associates a comprehensive benefits package with competitive salaries and more, including:

  • Competitive Bonus Program

  • 4 Weeks PTO for All New Associates (Pro-Rated by Hire Date)

  • 11 Holidays and 8 Early Release Days

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance

  • 401(k) with Company Match (Up to 5% Match)

  • Health Savings Account

  • Flexible Spending Accounts (Dependent & Medical Reimbursement)

  • Paid Parental Leave

  • Paid Volunteer Time

  • Tuition Assistance

  • Phone Reimbursement

  • Associate Referral Bonuses

ABOUT THE JOB

JPI has an exciting opportunity for an Integration Lead to join our DfX team in the West region.

This role is the technical and strategic connective point across design, permitting, and commercial work streams on assigned projects, driving coordination and problem-solving to keep design, approvals, and vendor commitments aligned through the DFX project life cycle. The Integration Lead drives integration excellence by providing hands-on expertise and guidance to keep projects on track, working alongside Technical Leads and Permit Leads as a subject matter expert in design coordination, regulatory strategy, and cross-functional problem-solving.

The position reports to the Director, DfX.

Essential Functions & Responsibilities

DFX Process Integration & Coordination

  • Drive integration strategy across technical, permitting, and commercial work streams on assigned projects, mentoring Technical Leads and Permit Leads to align on requirements and keep the DFX process moving end to end.
  • Lead identification and resolution of open items, decisions, and hand-offs across the full DFX life cycle, guiding the team to close gaps before they turn into schedule or cost impacts.
  • Establish and document best-practice process steps and hand-off points across the DFX life cycle, building organizational knowledge and a consistent, repeatable approach across projects.
  • Identify issues early and guide resolution by connecting the right stakeholders, serving as the technical authority on integration strategy and process excellence.

Design Phase Risk Management

  • Lead constructability reviews and de-risking sessions at every design milestone, guiding Technical Leads to integrate findings into the next phase and establish continuous improvement practices.
  • Own critical systems validation with consultants and trade partners, establishing standards for validation protocols and mentoring Technical Leads on closeout procedures.
  • Track the risk register and mitigation plan across projects, connecting design, permitting, and commercial inputs so open items don't stall between hand-offs.
  • Establish standards for drawing package quality and lead reviews to identify and prevent issues that historically cause rework or schedule impacts.

Permitting & Regulatory Ownership

  • Lead resolution of permitting issues as they arise across projects, guiding Permit Leads through problem-solving and providing expertise to clear roadblocks and keep approvals moving.
  • Lead the permitting strategy for assigned projects, establishing best practices for milestone tracking, submittal management, and delay mitigation across the team.
  • Serve as the lead technical contact with AHJ representatives on complex or high-risk issues, confirming requirements and translating agency feedback; mentor Permit Leads on standard engagement protocols.
  • Develop interpretation frameworks for agency feedback and translate into design and construction direction; share expertise with the team to build capability and avoid rejections or restarts.
  • Establish and maintain a knowledge base of city-specific requirements—including startup procedures, Temporary Certificate of Occupancy (TCO), Certificate of Occupancy (CO), and inspection sequencing—and guide alignment with building phasing plans.

Value Analysis

  • Lead Best Value analysis and decision-making across construction, design, and development teams, ensuring outcomes are reflected in IFC (issued for construction) drawing sets and establishing evaluation frameworks.
  • Develop evaluation criteria and lead analysis of alternative systems or materials that offer lifecycle cost benefits without sacrificing design intent; mentor team on value engineering methodology.
  • Maintain historical cost data and constructability benchmarks; leverage this data to validate Best Value recommendations and build organizational knowledge on value engineering outcomes.

Vendor Procurement & Commercial Integration

  • Lead vendor selection and procurement strategy for integration-related scopes, establishing qualification criteria and award methodology from evaluation through contract award.
  • Monitor soft-cost budgets for assigned projects against plan; identify variances early and guide corrective action with budget owners.
  • Drive alignment between technical execution, cost, and contract terms by leading cross-functional discussions with preconstruction and purchasing teams.
  • Establish integration protocols between technical and commercial work streams throughout the DFX phase; mentor team on balancing technical excellence with commercial constraints.

AI, Automation

  • Uses approved enterprise AI tools (e.g., Claude Cowork, Microsoft Copilot) to draft, summarize, analyze, and accelerate everyday work.
  • Leverage AI and other digital tools to document and then automate workflows effectively.

Non-Essential Functions & Responsibilities

  • Other duties as assigned.

Education, Work Experience, & Physical Requirements

  • Bachelor’s in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Architecture or a related field.
  • 1-4 years of progressive experience in design coordination, construction management, and/or permitting/regulatory strategy, preferably in the multifamily industry, with demonstrated subject matter expertise.
  • Expert-level knowledge of construction sequencing, drawing details, utility coordination, and permitting/AHJ processes. Advanced proficiency with Procore, Bluebeam, Oracle Primavera Cloud, AutoCAD, Revit, and permit tracking systems; ability to mentor others on these tools.
  • Proven experience in design feasibility, constructability assessments, and permit strategy across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Experience with vendor procurement and soft-cost budget management.
  • Demonstrated thought leadership and ability to guide teams through complex, multi-stakeholder coordination.
  • Experience coordinating across design, permitting, and commercial teams on complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
  • Act as a representative and advocate of JPI’s culture and guiding principles
  • 5-day work week (Monday-Friday) Physical Co-location
  • Frequent travel to AHJ offices as needed.
  • Daily Collaboration

General Base Pay Range

Please note that the posted annual base pay range reflects the anticipated compensation range for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation offered will be determined based on a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity with existing associates, and the Company’s budget at the time of the offer. This range applies to base salary only. Additional compensation, such as bonuses or incentive plans, may be available and will be discussed with the Recruiter during the interview process.

Annual Base Pay Range: $120,000-$170,000

description:
Biomedical Equipment Technician - (BMET) III

Do you envision a workplace where every team member works together to create an amazing workplace experience? The successful candidate will have outstanding skills and will be committed to working with others to deliver best-in-class, unparalleled excellence in customer service and satisfaction. For opportunities in your area, check out our Careers page at www.1soi.com/careers.

About the position:

The Biomedical Equipment Technician (BMET) III serves as a senior-level technical expert responsible for the maintenance, inspection, calibration, repair, and modernization, lifecycle management of medical equipment supporting the Army Medical Logistics Command (AMLC) Force Projection Directorate (FPD). This position provides advanced biomedical equipment support for Army Prepositioned Stocks (APS), Unit Deployment Packages (UDP), Medical Materiel Readiness Program (MMRP), Foreign Military Sales (FMS), and other medical readiness initiatives that directly support worldwide force projection and sustainment operations.

The BMET III independently performs highly complex technical tasks, provides expert consultation, and serves as a technical resource for Government personnel and junior technicians while ensuring the operational readiness of critical medical equipment assets.

Key Qualifications

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Advanced Medical Equipment Maintenance and Repair

  • Perform complex troubleshooting, diagnosis, repair, calibration, modification, and restoration of a wide variety of biomedical equipment and medical systems.
  • Independently resolve highly technical equipment malfunctions utilizing advanced diagnostic methods, engineering principles, and manufacturer specifications.
  • Conduct preventive maintenance inspections (PMI), electrical safety testing, operational verification, and performance assessments on critical medical devices.
  • Interpret engineering drawings, schematics, service manuals, technical bulletins, and regulatory guidance to support maintenance activities.

Medical Readiness and Force Projection Support

  • Ensure medical equipment supporting APS, UDP, MMRP, and other deployable medical programs remains fully mission capable and deployment ready.
  • Support equipment inspections, readiness assessments, inventories, fielding activities, and reconstitution efforts.
  • Assist in preparing medical equipment for operational deployments, contingency missions, exercises, and sustainment operations.
  • Evaluate equipment readiness and provide recommendations regarding serviceability, replacement, modernization, and sustainment requirements.

Technical Leadership and Advisory Support

  • Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for biomedical equipment maintenance and lifecycle management.
  • Provide technical guidance, training, and mentorship to junior BMET personnel and logistics staff.
  • Assist Government personnel in evaluating equipment performance, reliability, maintainability, and supportability.
  • Support root-cause analysis efforts and recommend corrective actions to resolve recurring equipment issues.

Equipment Lifecycle and Asset Management

  • Maintain comprehensive maintenance documentation, calibration records, repair histories, service reports, and technical data files.
  • Monitor equipment warranties, service contracts, maintenance schedules, and lifecycle replacement plans.
  • Support medical equipment acquisition planning by providing technical evaluations and recommendations.
  • Ensure accountability and visibility of Government-owned medical equipment assets.

Quality Assurance and Regulatory Compliance

  • Ensure maintenance activities comply with Department of Defense (DoD), Army, Joint Commission, FDA, OEM, and applicable industry standards.
  • Conduct quality control reviews and participate in inspections and compliance assessments.
  • Identify process improvements that increase equipment availability, reliability, and lifecycle performance.
  • Support development and implementation of maintenance procedures, technical guidance, and best practices.

description:

Job Details

Summary:


The Senior Director of Cyber Defense Architecture & Engineering leads the strategy, design, engineering, and continuous improvement of enterprise detection, response, and threat mitigation capabilities across the enterprise. This role is accountable for building or integrating resilient, intelligence-driven, automated cyber defense platforms spanning endpoint, network, cloud, identity, data, and SaaS environments. This role is responsible for building strong partnerships with technology teams, other corporate support functions, and other Information Security organizations to protect the corporate brand, data, and assets and is responsible for the design, implementation, operation, and maintenance of an information security framework, processes, and systems, that protect the business, services, information and systems against unauthorized use, disclosure, modification, damage, and loss.

The position partners closely with the CISO, Cyber Defense Sr. Leadership, other Information Security Sr. Leaders, and other Technology Leadership teams to establish a vision and strategy required to ensure scalable, measurable, and continuously improving defense capabilities across the applicable security domain in collaboration with other information security domain leaders and partner organizations.

Our employee experience is a strategic priority for our company. Our leaders are accountable for leading with purpose, fairness, and equity. They are responsible for building and developing diverse teams, maintaining a safe and inclusive environment, setting clear priorities, and holding self and team accountable for executing with excellence.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Define and execute the enterprise cyber defense architecture strategy aligned to threat landscape and risk appetite in collaboration with Cyber Defense senior leadership.

  • Develop layered defense models across endpoint, network, cloud, identity, and SaaS.

  • Establish and document detection engineering standards and reference architectures.

  • Collaborate & enable Zero Trust monitoring and enforcement architecture.

  • Present defense posture maturity, risk trends, and roadmap to executive leadership.

  • Establish the enterprise detection engineering program and lead evaluation of new tools and technologies to support the Cyber Defense ecosystem.

  • Define logging standards and telemetry requirements across platforms.

  • Collaborate & partner with key stakeholder to oversee use case lifecycle management (creation, tuning, retirement).

  • Standardize MITRE ATT&CK mapping across detections.

  • Reduce false positives while increasing true positive detection rates in collaboration with Cyber Defense teams.

  • Oversee or drive a collaborative approach to architecture and engineering of: | SIEM platforms | SOAR playbooks | EDR/XDR solutions | NDR solutions | Email security and anti-phishing platforms | Deception technologies | Threat intelligence platforms | Security data lakes and analytics platforms |

  • Drive automation, AI/ML integration, and policy-as-code for response workflows in collaboration with Cloud Security and other senior security leaders.

  • Enable automated containment and remediation capabilities.

  • Partner with Incident Response and Cyber Counter Adversary leadership for operational efficiency and maturity uplifts.

  • Support purple team exercises to validate detection and response effectiveness.

  • Integrate strategic, tactical, and operational threat intelligence into engineering roadmap.

title: Founding GTM, T:0
description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

About the team

T:0’s mission is to make finance run itself. We are turning accounting into autonomous infrastructure that closes the books, reconciles, and reports continuously, so the people who own the outcome can stop worrying about busy work and start focusing on strategic decisions. We're a small, elite, builder-focused team inside Airwallex, moving at startup speed with a scaled company's infrastructure and distribution behind us.

What you’ll do

You'll be our first GTM hire. There's no playbook to hand you - building it is the work. In practice it looks like sending the outbound yourself, working inbound lead that comes in, getting a founder from first call to paying customer in one conversation, and figuring out which channels actually produce before we spend real money on any of them. You'll try a bunch of things every week, most won't work, and you'll find the couple that do and go hard on them.

This role is based in San Francisco.

Responsibilities:

  • Build the GTM engine from scratch. Stand up and personally run our outbound motion — lists, sequences, messaging, follow-up. Triage and prioritize inbound. You're not managing this work; you're doing it.

  • Own the CRM and the sales process end to end. Define the stages, keep the data clean, and make the pipeline something the whole company can trust.

  • Sell to US startups, fast. Our current ICP is US-based seed-to-Series-A companies. The motion needs to be high-volume, low-friction, and ideally close in a single call - with a clear path toward self-serve and PLG. You'll design for that from day one.

  • Expand where the business goes next. The ICP won't stand still. As we grow, you'll open new segments yourself - sourcing the leads, running longer and more considered sales cycles, and building that motion alongside the fast one. Experience with more complex, multi-stakeholder deals is a real asset here.

  • Generate your own pipeline. In partnership with our Head of Marketing, you're responsible for making leads exist - not waiting for them to arrive.

  • Work closely with Airwallex's Startups team to keep the two motions aligned and compounding.

Who you are

We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

Minimum qualifications:

  • You've been the first (or only) GTM person somewhere before, and you liked it. You have a 0-to-1 mentality and real early-stage startup experience.

  • You've built a sales motion, not just operated one someone else already proved out.

  • You're comfortable selling to founders and operators at small companies - quick calls, quick decisions, high volume - and you've sold across deal shapes, including longer, multi-stakeholder cycles.

  • You're the person who books the thing instead of just suggesting it. If you can get a stranger on a call and leave with a yes, and you'd rather do something scrappy today than something perfect next week, we want to talk.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience selling fintech products, especially in accounting, bookkeeping, or the founder finance stack.

  • Have built out and managed a CRM

  • Have utilized AI to automate sales outbounding

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @ email address. Please apply only through or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. title: Director, Global Thought Leadership
description:
Job Description:

Seeking a strong and inquisitive researcher, data storyteller, and writer, to strengthen our understanding of how economic, societal, and public policy trends are shaping retirement, financial wellbeing, and workplace outcomes across U.S. and global markets. You will help lead Fidelity’s Global Thought Leadership program to engage and support large multinational employer clients and their employees. Drawing on a combination of proprietary research, primary research and external data sources, you will generate evidence-based insights that help Fidelity and our clients understand emerging challenges and opportunities in an evolving global landscape. You will partner closely with Thought Leadership colleagues, as well as research, marketing, and consulting partners to analyze a broad mix of data and insight sources. You will identify new opportunities to develop compelling thought leadership content and help communicate complex findings in a clear, engaging and actionable way. Working collaboratively across Fidelity, you will engage with subject matter experts in retirement, benefits, and client strategy. You will also work closely with go-to-market teams to ensure insights are translated into impactful reports, client-facing presentations, reports, industry commentary, social media, and more. The role is accountable for research and thought leadership strategy, insight development, stakeholder engagement, content governance, regulatory oversight, regional activation, budget management and vendor management.

About your team
The Global Thought Leadership Team sits within Fidelity's Research and Thought Leadership function. The team develops innovative research and evidence-based insights that help shape global perspectives on retirement, financial wellbeing, workplace benefits and the future of work. Our work supports multinational employers in understanding the evolving needs of their workforce and navigating an increasingly complex landscape shaped by demographic change, economic trends, workforce dynamics and public policy.

Expectations of this role
Develop and deliver the Global Thought Leadership strategy, ensuring alignment with FWC and FIL priorities.
Establish the annual research agenda by identifying emerging client issues, market developments and commercial opportunities.
Ensure research programs support consulting priorities, regional business objectives and long-term strategic initiatives.
Drive continuous evolution of the research program to maximize business relevance and commercial value.
Research Program Leadership: Lead the design and delivery of proprietary global research programs.
Insight Development: Translate quantitative and qualitative research into commercially relevant insight. Interpret research findings to identify emerging themes, behavioral trends and strategic implications.
Client & Commercial Engagement: Serve as subject matter expert for Global Thought Leadership in support of client engagement activities. Support executive client meetings, strategic presentations, webinars and industry events. Brief senior leaders for client engagements, conferences, media activity and external speaking opportunities.
Stakeholder management: Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Fidelity Investments and Fidelity International. Align research priorities with consulting, marketing, communications and regional business plans.
Content Strategy Governance: Provide strategic oversight of the development and publication of all Global Thought Leadership research outputs. Ensure research is translated into engaging, accurate and commercially relevant client insights. Maintain editorial quality and consistency across all formats and channels.
Regional Activation: Work with regional marketing and consulting teams in key markets to maximize the value of global research. With a ‘globally consistent, locally relevant’ mindset, ensure global programs can be effectively adapted for local market conditions.
Governance, Risk & Compliance: Ensure all Global Thought Leadership outputs comply with applicable regulatory requirements. Maintain governance processes supporting content review, approval and publication.

The Skills You Bring
Comfort with leading discussions, influencing partners and stakeholders, and motivating colleagues.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex findings clearly and confidently.
Strong research and analytical skills.
An interest in retirement preparedness, financial wellbeing, workforce participation and the future of work, behavioral economics, coupled with the ability to connect academic, industry and market research to emerging trends.
Demonstrated passion for understanding customer needs and translating research into compelling stories that resonate with a range of audiences, from senior leaders to clients and industry stakeholders.
Experience conducting, writing and publishing research on workforce, retirement, financial wellbeing, employee benefits, customer behavior or broader market trends. Experience working across multiple countries or regions is preferred.

The Expertise You Bring
An undergraduate degree in Economics, Public Policy, Business, or a related field, with 12+ years of experience in a research, policy, or thought leadership role.
Understanding of the broad global retirement/workplace benefits landscape
Proficiency in synthesizing complex data into novel and engaging insights
Ability to partner and collaborate effectively with regional teams across FWC & FIL.
Experience with program management, supplier procurement, contract management and budget allocation.
Coaching and management experience of junior team members

The Value You Deliver
Delivers research insights with commercial opportunities
Develop engaging content for various audiences
Articulates key messages and points-of-view that enable strategic conversations internally and with employers, advisors, and other key audiences
Boosts impact of Fidelity thought leadership through strong partnership with Fidelity marketing, client-facing, and communications teams.
Presents compelling thought leadership stories internally

title: Senior Technician, Quality
location: Altria (East Jackson St, Richmond) - Customer Site VA
description:
When joining PerkinElmer, you select an experienced and trusted leader in scientific solutions, with the support of a global service network and distribution centers, providing the right solution, at the right time, to meet critical customer needs. With over an 80+ year legacy of advancing science and a mission of innovating for a healthier world, our dedicated team collaborates closely with commercial, government, academic and healthcare customers to deliver our broad portfolio of analytical solutions, and OneSource services.

Job Title

Senior Technician, Quality


Location(s)

Altria (East Jackson St, Richmond) - Customer Site VA

Job Description

The Sr. Technician, Quality supports quality assurance and quality control operations for the insourced laboratory team as part of an End-to-End (E2E) Laboratory Modernization Program. Depending on assignment, this role concentrates in one or more of the following areas: CAPA and non-conformance management, document control, metrology and equipment calibration, records management and digitization, or personnel training and qualification. Because these functions operate as a single Quality team, staff routinely support one another across these areas as workload requires. This role operates within an ISO 17025 accredited analytical production laboratory at a client site. The Senior Technician independently performs advanced sample preparation and laboratory support activities for these functions and provides guidance to Technician staff.

This is a fixed shift position: Shift A, 0700 to 1500, Monday through Friday, with weekend overtime as applicable based on business needs. This shift does not rotate.

Job Responsibilities

  • Maintain controlled documents, including SOPs, work instructions, forms, and quality records, and coordinate revisions, approvals, archival, and retention requirements.
  • Coordinate calibration and maintenance activities for laboratory instrumentation, maintain equipment qualification and calibration records, and ensure measurement traceability.
  • Perform scanning, indexing, and electronic filing of laboratory records and quality documents; support records retrieval and archival activities.
  • Coordinate laboratory training programs, maintain training records, and support onboarding, qualification, and competency assessments for laboratory personnel.
  • Track CAPA records, calibration schedules, and training compliance to ensure timely completion and effectiveness.
  • Review documentation for completeness, accuracy, and compliance with quality requirements across CAPA, document control, metrology, records, and training activities.
  • Support internal and external audits, inspection readiness, and regulatory compliance activities across all quality functions.
  • Facilitate cross-functional discussions involving laboratory personnel, quality representatives, and stakeholders.
  • Identify opportunities to improve quality systems and streamline processes across CAPA, document control, metrology, records management, and training.
  • Maintain training and compliance in health, safety, environmental, and operational requirements.
  • Train and provide day-to-day guidance to Technician staff on prep procedures, SOPs, and safe work practices.
  • Perform basic troubleshooting of routine preparation equipment and escalate complex issues appropriately.
  • Perform quality checks on completed prep work prior to hand-off for analysis.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and well-stocked work area, including routine housekeeping and supply inventory.

Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities of this job at any time.

Critical Skills:

  • Strong understanding of CAPA principles, deviation management, and root cause analysis techniques.
  • Knowledge of document control, records management, and metrology/calibration program requirements.
  • Ability to coordinate training programs and competency assessments.
  • Knowledge of ISO 17025 quality systems and regulatory requirements.
  • Excellent organizational skills, technical writing, and documentation review capabilities.
  • Effective communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data integrity principles.

Basic Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent with 2+ years of relevant laboratory or manufacturing experience.
  • OR Associate degree in a science-related field with 1+ years of relevant experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and mentor others in a regulated laboratory environment.
  • Adaptable, self-motivated, and capable of managing multiple concurrent prep tasks with minimal supervision.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience managing CAPA systems and non-conformance investigations, including root cause analysis and continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Experience supporting document control systems, records management, and electronic document/records platforms.
  • Experience coordinating calibration and equipment maintenance programs; familiarity with metrology software and asset management systems.
  • Experience developing or coordinating training programs and maintaining competency/qualification records; familiarity with learning management systems.
  • Experience within ISO 17025, GLP, GMP, or FDA-regulated environments.
  • Familiarity with LIMS and electronic documentation platforms.

Working Environment:

  • Must be able to work in a laboratory, controlled environments requiring personal protective equipment (e.g., lab coat, safety glasses, etc.) in laboratory.
  • Job pace may be fast and job completion demands may be high.
  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position more than 25% of the time.
  • The person needs to occasionally move between labs, corridors, adjoining rooms, and buildings onsite. Frequently operate on instruments, objects, tools or controls, which will require regularly bending, squatting, stretching and reaching in order to perform in a service function.
  • Occasionally move or lift up to 25 pounds (potential for occasional lifting of up to 50 pounds).
  • Specific vision abilities required by this position include without limitation, the ability to observe details at close range distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus in order to perform the essential service functions of this position.
  • Occasionally operates a computer and other office machinery, such as a calculator, copy machine, and computer printer.
  • Employee may be required to handle hazardous waste according to local, state, and federal regulations. Duties may include identifying, handling, generating, accumulating, storing and labeling hazardous waste.
  • Potential risk to lab-based hazards including but not limited to extreme temperature, biological materials, and hazardous chemicals.
  • May be required to complete Medical Clearance, Respiratory Protection Training, and Fit Testing to wear a respirator as protection against hazards present in the laboratory environment.

The annual compensation range for this full-time position is $50,000 to $60,000. The final base pay offered to the successful candidate will be determined by factors including internal equity, work location, as well as individual qualifications, such as job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

PerkinElmer is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability status, age, or veteran status or any other characteristics protected by applicable law. PerkinElmer is committed to a culturally diverse workforce.

title: Senior Institutional Services Automation Quality Control Analyst (Payments)
description:
Overview:

The Wilmington Trust Institutional Services (IS) division is experiencing rapid business growth and has initiated a strategic program of continuous improvement to support the growth objectives. The goals of the program are to reduce operational issues and risks by standardizing processes, implementing best practices in key areas, and adding new governance and control functions. In addition, long term digital transformation is required to grow revenue through new and transformed digital-first trust and agency service products, to move from a product-centric to client-centric operating model, to move from market-specific to global solutions, and to dramatically lower the cost to serve. These two strategic focus areas are driving growth in overall business investment.

Job Summary:

In alignment with the business strategy, we are seeking an entrepreneurial and highly analytical Senior IS Automation Quality Control Analyst to ensure the efficient delivery of high-quality business processes for Money Movement and Fees capabilities by designing, developing, and executing automated test scripts that support software products for the Bank’s Institutional Services (IS) customers. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to understand system architecture, product requirements, and deliver test automation solutions that ensure both functional and non-functional quality coverage. Reporting to the QA Manager to support Money Movement & Fees, you will be responsible for defining and executing the manual & automation testing for core capabilities such as client receipts and disbursements, payment risk management and migrations, billing and invoicing, exception handling, and operational controls.

You will also share accountability for production support, partnering with technology and operations teams to perform post production validation and ensure the ongoing stability and reliability of Money Movement and Fees capabilities.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Develop, maintain and execute manual and automated test scripts for web, API (Application Programming Interface), and/or mobile applications using appropriate tools and frameworks.
  • Collaborate with Development teams to understand system architecture and implementation; collaborate with Product Owner team by engaging in regular sprint planning and backlog grooming sessions to understand product requirements and acceptance criteria, translating them into comprehensive test automation scripts that ensure coverage of both functional and non-functional requirements.
  • Collaborate with engineers to integrate automated tests into CI/CD (Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment) pipelines using the appropriate tools ensuring seamless and efficient test execution throughout the development life cycle.
  • Report defects clearly, verify fixes, and contribute to continuous improvement of the quality assurance process.
  • Complete root cause analysis of test failures and assist with debugging issues alongside the development team.
  • Ensure sufficient test data set-up and environment readiness for automation runs.
  • Maintain automation documentation and publish automation test execution status report with traceability of test coverage at feature level and communicate it to stakeholders.
  • Understand and adhere to the Company’s risk and regulatory standards, policies and controls in accordance with the Company’s Risk Appetite. Identify risk-related issues needing escalation to management.
  • Promote an environment that supports a culture of belonging and reflects the M&T Bank brand.
  • Maintain M&T internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators as applicable.
  • Complete other related duties as assigned.

Education and Experience Required:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field and a minimum of 2 years’ software quality assurance and control experience, with creation and maintenance of test scripts for desktop/web applications/API/webservices testing or in lieu of a degree, a combined minimum of 6 years’ higher education and/or work experience, including a minimum of 2 years’ software quality assurance and control experience, with creation and maintenance of test scripts for desktop/web applications/API/webservices testing

Strong programming skills in one or more pertinent languages

Sound understanding of quality control methodologies, tools, and processes

Sound knowledge of agile development methodologies and Development Operations practices

Familiarity with pertinent defect tracking systems

Strong problem-solving skills

Strong verbal and written communication skills

Strong organizational skills

Education and Experience Preferred:

Minimum of 7 years’ software quality assurance and control experience

Experience in testing cloud-based applications and APIs

Strong domain expertise in Money Movement and Fees capabilities, including client receipts and disbursements, billing triggers, exception handling, and operational controls.

Deep expertise in payment systems and payment processing concepts, including but not limited to: payment submission and orchestration, authentication and authorization, clearing and settlement, idempotency, error detection, and exception management.

Strong understanding of payment risk, controls, and fraud management, including: preventative and detective controls, operational risk, resiliency and auditability

Exposure to fintech platforms and emerging technologies, with a solid understanding of modern digital ecosystems and integration patterns.

Exposure to AI concepts and tools (e.g., AI-assisted testing, test data generation, intelligent automation) is highly preferred, with the ability to apply AI-driven approaches to improve QA efficiency and coverage.

ISTQB (International Software Testing Qualifications Board) or similar QA certification

Experience with pertinent performance and load testing tools

Exposure to security testing practices and tools

title: Staff Product Manager
description:
Staff Product Manager

The Staff Product Manager is Orion's most senior individual contributor track in product. This is a player-coach role: a Staff PM raises the bar through their own craft — shipping the hardest problems themselves, modeling AI-native product development, and actively mentoring a small group of peer PMs — without carrying direct reports. Staff PMs sit directly under a GM, signaling that builders have a first-class path to the most senior levels of product leadership.

Essential Functions of the Job

  • Own the highest-leverage, ambiguous, or hardest-to-solve problems in the pillar — the platform-level bets and the initiatives where the outcome matters most
  • Personally ship the work: PRDs, prototypes, shipped features, customer research synthesis, and post-launch analyses — at the quality bar the rest of the team calibrates against
  • Build and deploy AI-native workflows: prototype in AI coding tools, run discovery and synthesis through LLMs, ship internal agents that eliminate repetitive work, and publish those workflows as team standards
  • Partner with engineering leadership on technical direction for the pillar — data contracts, AI/model integration decisions, platform investments
  • Translate GM-level strategy into a crisp, opinionated product vision for the pillar; set the product quality bar the team works against
  • Run end-to-end discovery: customer interviews, data analysis, competitive research, opportunity sizing — AI-accelerated at every stage
  • Lead cross-pillar initiatives that touch more than one product, where a senior IC perspective is more valuable than a management handoff
  • Represent the pillar in customer executive conversations, industry forums, and cross-functional executive reviews

Player-Coach Responsibilities (no direct reports)

  • Mentor 3–6 peer PMs through weekly 1:1s, PRD reviews, shadowing on discovery calls, and pair-shipping on hard problems
  • Raise the team's AI fluency: teach AI-native workflows, maintain the pillar's prompt and agent library, review AI-generated artifacts for quality
  • Own the hiring bar for the pillar's PM hires; lead technical interview loops and make hire/no-hire calls alongside the GM
  • Be the person peers escalate to when stuck — unblock them and make the call on hard tradeoffs
  • Model operating norms (documentation, async comms, meeting hygiene) that keep the team flat and fast

Skills

  • Proven track record of shipping successful products at senior IC level
  • Deep, demonstrable AI fluency — has built features powered by LLMs, ships prototypes in modern AI coding tools, understands eval frameworks, cost tradeoffs, and agent architectures; this is not "has used ChatGPT"
  • Strong technical instincts — reads code, writes SQL, works fluently with APIs, holds substantive conversations with senior engineers
  • World-class written communication; writes the clearest PRD in the room
  • Mastery of discovery craft — customer interviews, competitive teardowns, data analysis, synthesis
  • Evidence of raising the bar for teammates (mentorship outcomes, artifacts adopted as team standards, successful hires championed)
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a strong bias to ship

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience
  • 10+ years in product management or product engineering, with clear evidence of increasing scope and complexity
  • At least one tour in a heavily AI-forward or technically deep product role

KPIs

  • Pillar outcomes directly driven (revenue, retention, activation, or NPS on owned surfaces) — targets set with GM; trend positive QoQ
  • AI leverage index (features shipped per engineer on the pillar) — top quartile vs. company benchmark
  • Peer PM growth — ≥ 2 mentees per year with documented scope expansion, promotion, or new surface ownership
  • Hiring bar — offers extended by this Staff PM that accept and are performing well at the 12-month mark — ≥ 80%
  • Artifacts adopted — PRDs, prompts, agents, or frameworks built by this PM and adopted by other PMs on the team — ≥ 4 per year
  • Customer-evidenced initiatives — ≥ 80% of work led has pre-launch validated customer evidence

Recommended Skills:

Change Management, Conflict Management, Cross-Functional Collaboration, Financial Management, Investment Management, Product Development, Product Management, Strategic Influence, Strategic Risk Management, Succession Planning, Technical Strategy

Salary Range:

$123,491.00 - $196,279.00

The pay listed in this posting indicates the estimated pay at the time of this posting; however, may vary depending on geographic location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition, Orion offers a competitive benefits package which includes health, dental, vision, and disability coverage on day one, 401(k) plan with employer match, paid parental leave, pet benefits including pawternity leave and pet insurance, student loan repayment and more.

About Us

At Orion, we achieve our best work when we support one another, staying personally accountable to each other and the clients we serve. We create a welcoming environment where everyone is respected, valued, and heard. Our commitment to create raving fans ensures we consistently exceed client expectations. Thinking differently is in our DNA—we innovate always, push boundaries, and reject the status quo to deliver transformative outcomes. Together, we support one another and see it through to success, driving our collective achievements and those of our clients.
